svg.title: Projection wireframe
svg.text: Rising to 2045, then drawdown. Rerunning replaces this chart from the new result.
One annual pipeline: income → contributions → expenses and debt → RMDs and conversions → surplus or shortfall →
Every run is versioned with start time and duration. Selecting an older run shows that result, not a recomputation.
Summary values are the same API response the chart uses. The UI formats, never calculates.
Warnings are data: a shortfall or invalid input names the issue and the year and marks the failure year on the
